crossRefs.note: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please…
“If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and…
He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know…
Elisha left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, “Let me please kiss my father and my mother, and then I will…
Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in…
He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t…
He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me, isn’t worthy of me.

translations.web: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”
translations.bsb: Still another said, “I will follow You, Lord; but first let me bid farewell to my family.”
translations.kjv: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.
translations.asv: And another also said, I will follow thee, Lord; but first suffer me to bid farewell to them that are at my house.
